title: N -W F P Bank of Khyber Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Bank of Khyber Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE BANK OF KHYBER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE BANK OF KHYBER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE II OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Bank of Khyber Act, 1991
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 19th January, 2002]
No. Legis. I(4)91/412-17.,
dated 19-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This ordinance may be called the Bank of Khyber
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Bank of Khyber Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Substitution of section 8 of N.-W.F.P. Act No. XIV of 1991

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE BANK OF KHYBER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE BANK OF KHYBER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE II OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Bank of Khyber Act, 1991
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 19th January, 2002]
No. Legis. I(4)91/412-17.,
dated 19-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Substitution of section 8
of N.-W.F.P. Act No. XIV of 1991.--In the Bank of Khyber Act, 1991
(N.-W.F.P. Act No. XIV of 19911, for section 8, the following shall be
substituted namely:
8. Government to be
shareholder.--Government shall be the major shareholder of the Bank,
but shall not, except for such time till shares of the Bank are floated to the
public, hold more than fifty-one percent. of the shares issued by the
Bank."
